title: Ops Captain Weekly Debrief — serving runtime
body:
Purpose: quick, practical agenda for this week’s serving-runtime bridge. Focus: unresolved regressions, console deploy checklist, and runway items for Dedicated autoscale tests. This is a scratchpad — live notes during call.

Quick snapshot metrics (top-of-call):
- 99th P99 latency (hosted default route): 142ms (up from 128ms last week) — suspect batching config drift on gpu-pool-a
- Error-rate (server-side 5xx): 0.7% last 24h (target <0.3%) — spike coincided with model-switch rollout at 03:00 UTC
- Cost per 1k tokens (observed): $0.75 (quantized variants pushed costs down on batch-heavy jobs)
- Cache hit ratio (prefix-KV): 63% overall; customer x1 has 85% and is driving most token savings

Agenda (30m total)
1) Rollouts & incidents (8m) — quick status updates
   - Follow-up: INFRA-1204 investigate model-switch rollback and 3xx->5xx coupling (owner: Priya) — due 2026-03-14
   - Quick ask to SRE: confirm whether autoscaler churn contributed to dropped connections during the 03:00 rollout window (owner: Diego) — due 2026-03-13 EOD

2) Console & tracing gaps (6m)
   - UX: token-level breakdown missing at route-level for Dedicated customers; quick mock: add route filter in cost view (owner: Mikael) — prototype by 2026-03-17
   - Note: add a small checkbox to rollouts UI for "preserve KV-cache" so we can test canaries w/o cold starts.

3) Latency hypothesis triage (8m)
   - Hypothesis A: batching size auto-tuner bumped batch-window for gpu-pool-a after recent kernel update.
   - Hypothesis B: new quantized kernel path has worse small-seq latency (edge cases).
   - Action: run quick perf matrix: seq_len {64,128,256} x batch_size {1,4,16} on pool-a and pool-b (owner: Rowan) — run by 2026-03-13, log to CON-4531

4) Dedicated capacity smoke plan (4m)
   - Next week we run a synthetic burst test (75% sustained for 10m then 120% burst for 60s). Need runbook + fallback.
   - Owner: Diego to draft rollback hooks and circuit breaker thresholds — due 2026-03-16

5) Parking lot / ops-captain notes (4m)
   - Follow-up with product about exposing per-model quantization profile in console.
   - Draft proposal for cost-aware routing policy (short doc) — if adopted, ops will use it to favor quantized candidates for non-latency-critical routes. Owner: Rowan — first draft 2026-03-20

Action items (tracked)
- INFRA-1204: root-cause model-switch 5xx spike (owner: Priya Nair; status: in_progress; due: 2026-03-14)
- Autoscaler churn investigation (owner: Diego Alvarez; status: todo; due: 2026-03-13)
- Prototype route-level token breakdown in Console UI (owner: Mikael Gomez; status: todo; due: 2026-03-17)
- Perf matrix on pool-a/pool-b for recent kernel (owner: Rowan Patel; status: todo; due: 2026-03-13)
- Draft rollback/circuit breaker for Dedicated smoke test (owner: Diego Alvarez; status: todo; due: 2026-03-16)
- Cost-aware routing short proposal (owner: Rowan Patel; status: backlog; due: 2026-03-20)

Notes to self (rowan) — quick scratchlist:
- Remind product that "preserve KV-cache" checkbox needs SLO language for canaries
- Add short checklist for on-call handover (what to include: last 24h anomalies, active rollouts, pending action items)
- Push a quick alert to ops Slack for P99 > 200ms to avoid silent drift

Open questions / unresolved:
- Was the rollback of the model-switch a full reimage of nodes or just route weight change? (Priya to confirm)
- Do we have a safe default for batch-window that limits P99 regressions across mixed seq distributions?

Meeting prep checklist (before call)
- [ ] Pull last 24h traces for model-switch timeframe (Rowan)
- [ ] Surface top-3 routes by token volume (Mikael)
- [ ] Confirm DR runbook is updated for dedicated smoke (Diego)

Live notes (fill during call):
- 03:04 UTC — Priya: discovered mismatch in rollout script; weights applied twice; leads to overloading a subset. Plan: small hotfix and coordinated retry.
- 03:22 UTC — Diego: autoscaler restart happened 03:01 due to k8s node drain; possibly correlated.
- 03:28 UTC — Action: block model-switch rollouts during node maintenance windows (policy item)

Follow-up communication drafts:
- Slack blurb (ops): "Heads-up: model-switch rollout caused elevated 5xx this morning. Working on fix; please avoid manual weight changes during node maintenance. See INFRA-1204 for details."
- Email to product (short): outline proposal to add "preserve KV-cache" as canary option + request for per-model quantization profile visibility.

End-of-note: keep this file lightweight. Move completed items to a weekly runbook doc (shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime/runbooks) once stable.
